# Importing data

The images for this contest are:

- grayscale, so we only need one *color channel*;
- only 48 by 48 pixels.
- 2538 images in the training set.

Reading in images pixelwise is easiest: We simply store each image as a long vector of
pixel intensities, column by column. Also we will need a vector that contains the
emotion label for each of the images.

```{r pixels-1, code=readLines("R/features/raw_pixels.R"), fold="Raw pixel functions", message=FALSE}
source("R/features/raw_pixels.R", local = TRUE, print.eval = TRUE)
```

```{r pixels-2}
pixels <- prepare_pixels(image_files)
x_train <- pixels$x_train
y <- pixels$y
x_test <- pixels$x_test
```
